SUMMARY: The change to require a typed TypeRegistration struct instead of variadic Object arguments will break all files that call scheme.AddKnownTypes to register CRD types. Across the four operators, these calls are found in dedicated registration files and in main setup code where the scheme is initialized.

FILES:
- cert-manager/pkg/client/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/scheme.go — registers cert-manager CRD types to the scheme
- cert-manager/pkg/client/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/register.go — contains AddKnownTypes calls for cert-manager API groups
- external-secrets/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/scheme.go — registers external-secrets CRD types to the scheme
- external-secrets/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/register.go — contains AddKnownTypes calls for external-secrets API groups
- grafana-operator/controllers/model/monitoring/v1alpha1/register.go — registers Grafana monitoring CRD types to the scheme
- grafana-operator/controllers/model/monitoring/v1beta1/register.go — registers Grafana monitoring CRD types to the scheme
- opentelemetry-operator/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/scheme.go — registers OpenTelemetry CRD types to the scheme
- opentelemetry-operator/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/scheme/register.go — contains AddKnownTypes calls for OpenTelemetry API groups
